opening.argument: The video leads with a promise of Rs 150 in a Paytm wallet every five seconds, while its description says downloading the application will bring Rs 4000 daily. The speaker then directs viewers to enter a name and phone number and describes completing views to receive coins or a claimed Paytm withdrawal. These steps turn the earnings pitch into a request for registration and timed activity. A sampled ₹5 cashback screen shows only that smaller receipt; it does not independently establish the larger advertised payments, how the application operates, or successful withdrawals at those amounts.
